topArticle.title: Controversial vaccine trial touted by RFK Jr gets go-ahead in Guinea-Bissau

Recommended dose of hepatitis B vaccine will be withheld from thousands of newborns by Danish researchers
A controversial research trial that will withhold hepatitis B vaccines from some African newborns was given approval to move forward this week.
It is a central part of the vaccine vision for Robert F Kennedy Jr, the secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime vaccine opponent.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.title: Egyptian journalists plan weekend protest over detention of six colleagues
topArticle.description:
Matsadaash staff allege torture and forced confessions after being held on charges of working for Muslim Brotherhood
Egyptian journalists are planning a new protest in Cairo this weekend after six colleagues were charged with terrorism offences amid allegations they had been tortured in police detention.
Last week, Egyptian authorities arrested the journalists, from the independent factchecking and investigative platform Matsadaash, accusing them in a statement of being unlicensed and producing false news on behalf of the outlawed Muslim Brotherhood.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.title: Scientists discover 180,000 giant tortoises on one Seychelles island
topArticle.description:
Free-roaming Aldabra population far exceeds human population of Seychelles after decades-long recovery programme
A survey of the world’s largest free-roaming giant tortoise population has discovered that the once endangered species is thriving.
A population of Aldabra giant tortoises lives on an island in Seychelles called Aldabra Atoll.

topArticle.titleJa: 科学者、セーシェル諸島の1島で18万頭のゾウガメを発見

topArticle.title: UK asks Interpol to reject Argentina’s ‘politically motivated’ requests for Falklands oil arrests

Britain has appealed to Interpol to reject Argentina’s requests for the arrest of individuals involved in a large oil project off the Falkland Islands.
With tensions over the sovereignty of the British overseas territory reaching levels not seen since the war with Argentina in 1982, UK officials have sought urgent assurances from the international organisation.

topArticle.title: How a scandal engulfing Brazil’s top court could return the Bolsonaros to power
topArticle.description:
The judge who helped convict Jair Bolsonaro is caught up in a crisis that could benefit his son and damage Lula

Marina Silva on Flávio Bolsonaro: He will try to finish his father’s ‘perverse project’ to destroy the Amazon

Thundering to a crowd of thousands of far-right supporters in São Paulo on 7 September, Brazil’s Independence Day, the senator Flávio Bolsonaro focused less on his opponent in the presidential election, the leftist president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, than on someone who is not running at all.
“Whoever votes for Lula is voting for Alexandre de Moraes,” Bolsonaro shouted, referring to the shaven-headed supreme court justice once described as “Voldemort” by Elon Musk.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ブラジル最高裁を巻き込むスキャンダルがボルソナーロ家を政権復帰させる可能性

topArticle.title: Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel kill five people on Mexico’s Pacific coast

Security forces use helicopters to rescue dozens of people as the two storms damage infrastructure and cause flash flooding
At least five people have died after Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel pummelled Mexico’s Pacific coast, causing flooding that downed trees and electricity poles, blocked roads and inundated homes.
Simon claimed the life of a 71-year-old man who died when a wall collapsed in Chilpancingo in the southern state of Guerrero, governor Evelyn Salgado said at a press conference.

topArticle.summary: モザンビークの若者にとって、法的に保障された表現の自由には代償が伴うことがある。音楽は批判と抵抗の強力な手段となっている。

topArticle.title: What #EndSARS left behind in Nigeria: A generation caught between protest, politics, and departure
topArticle.description: The protests strengthened the political consciousness of some young Nigerians and encouraged greater participation in elections, governance and activism. For others, the experience produced fear, distrust and disillusionment.
topArticle.titleJa: #EndSARSがナイジェリアに残したもの：抗議、政治、そして離脱に挟まれた世代
topArticle.summary: ナイジェリアの#EndSARS抗議活動は、一部の若者の政治意識を高め選挙参加を促したが、同時に他の者には恐怖や不信、幻滅をもたらした。

topArticle.title: How Togolese people are reinventing political protest amid civil society crackdown
topArticle.description: As in-person gatherings have become difficult to organize or too risky for citizens, online protest has become an increasingly common form of political dissent in Togo.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民社会弾圧の中、トーゴの人々が政治的抗議活動を再発明する方法
topArticle.summary: トーゴでは、対面での集会が困難になったため、市民社会への弾圧の中でオンラインでの抗議活動が政治的反対意見を表明する上で一般的な手段となっている。

topArticle.title: Man rescued after being trapped in Sardinian cave for 26 hours
topArticle.description: The 31-year-old cave expert was found alive, 32ft underground, after more than 100 emergency personnel worked to free him.
topArticle.titleJa: サルデーニャの洞窟で26時間閉じ込められた男性を救出
topArticle.summary: イタリアのサルデーニャ島で、31歳の洞窟専門家が26時間洞窟に閉じ込められた後、100人以上の救助隊によって無事救出された。

topArticle.title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung
topArticle.description: The 71-year-old pontiff said the nodule was identified "at a very early stage".
topArticle.titleJa: ローマ教皇レオ、肺に腫瘤発見で手術へ
topArticle.summary: 71歳のローマ教皇レオが肺に初期段階の腫瘤が発見されたため、手術を受けることを発表した。容体は安定しているという。

topArticle.title: Potentially paralysed tourist stranded in Greece after balcony fall
topArticle.description: Denby McLaren has a broken vertebra and multiple fractures to her foot
topArticle.titleJa: バルコニーから転落、麻痺の恐れのある観光客がギリシャで足止め
topArticle.summary: ギリシャでバルコニーから転落した観光客デンビー・マクラーレンさんが、脊椎骨折と足の多発骨折のため麻痺の可能性があり、現地で足止めされている。

topArticle.title: Venezuela's ex-leader Nicolás Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
topArticle.description: The new accusations relate to the alleged torture of US citizens held in Venezuela while Maduro was in power.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ元指導者ニコラス・マドゥロ、拷問共謀罪で起訴
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラのニコラス・マドゥロ元指導者が、在任中に米国市民を拷問した疑いで新たに共謀罪で起訴された。

topArticle.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
topArticle.description: Tsunami warnings are issued for neighbouring countries as videos of destruction circulate online.
topArticle.titleJa: パナマでマグニチュード7.7の強力な地震が発生、建物に被害
topArticle.summary: パナマでマグニチュード7.7の強い地震が発生し、建物が損傷。周辺国には津波警報が出された。

topArticle.title: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
topArticle.description: The Mapocho river has burst its banks after an unusually large amount of rain fell in recent days.
topArticle.titleJa: チリ中部で洪水発生、住民が空路で避難
topArticle.summary: 最近の異常な降雨によりマポチョ川が氾濫し、チリ中部で洪水が発生。住民が安全な場所へ空路で避難した。

topArticle.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
topArticle.description: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.
topArticle.titleJa: ペルーで「ヒトラー・ムッソリーニ」と名乗る男性が市長に当選
topArticle.summary: ペルーのアンデス山脈の遠隔地で、異色の名前を持つ左派候補者が僅差で市長に当選した。

topArticle.title: The small African nation ready for Messi's big night
topArticle.description: Benin are about to have their own moment in the limelight as they visit Argentina for Lionel Messi's final game.
topArticle.titleJa: 小さなアフリカの国、メッシの最後の夜に備える
topArticle.summary: 小国ベナンが、リオネル・メッシのアルゼンチン代表としての最終戦に出場するためアルゼンチンを訪問し、脚光を浴びる。

topArticle.title: How Ecuador is fighting to keep industrial trans fats off the food shelf
topArticle.description: As health advocates push for tighter controls, Ecuador confronts the gap between regulating trans fats and enforcing those rules.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルはいかに工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚から排除しようと闘っているか
topArticle.summary: エクアドルが工業用トランス脂肪酸の規制と執行の間のギャップに直面しながら、食品からの排除を目指す取り組みについて。健康推進者がより厳しい規制を求めている。

topArticle.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
topArticle.summary: コロンビア・ペレイラで、地震生存者たちは日払い部屋生活、ホームレス化、過密シェルター、病気、存在の苦闘に直面している。

topArticle.title: Eight injured in South Korea knife attack
topArticle.description: Using knives strapped to his hands, a man reportedly stabbed several people at a shopping centre in Incheon.
topArticle.titleJa: 韓国で刃物襲撃、8人負傷
topArticle.summary: 韓国の仁川にあるショッピングセンターで男が刃物で複数の人を襲撃し、8人が負傷した。

topArticle.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
topArticle.description: Nepal is still trying to recover from catastrophic floods that hit less than two months ago, leaving thousands dead and missing.
topArticle.titleJa: ネパールを再び洪水が襲い、家屋や橋が流される
topArticle.summary: ネパールで新たな洪水が発生し、家屋や橋が流された。同国は2ヶ月前の壊滅的な洪水からの復旧途上にある。

topArticle.title: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
topArticle.description: A desperate junta is in a war of attrition against ethnic militias and civilian resistance.
topArticle.titleJa: ミャンマー、若者たちが街頭で誘拐され軍に売られる恐怖に暮らす
topArticle.summary: ミャンマーでは、追い詰められた軍事政権が民族民兵や市民抵抗勢力との消耗戦を繰り広げており、若者たちは軍への強制徴兵を恐れている。

topArticle.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
topArticle.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカルが一部菓子製品に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: マダガスカルは、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート・ココア菓子の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始した。これはWTOに通知された貿易保護措置である。
